Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Independent emissivity/view-factor balance; equal-temperature enclosure gives zero net exchange.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Shared geometry/material collision exchanges momentum; separated bodies receive no contact impulse. Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Two finite masses: conservation of linear/angular momentum; separating control has zero impulse.

Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Tangential work is nonpositive; zero normal load gives zero Coulomb traction; heat equals lost mechanical energy.
